rule: Keep every received event in Bronze; Silver has one row per cdr_id
window_or_watermark: Exact event duplicate or same/older event_time
rejected_record_handling: Do not reject from Bronze; log as ignored in stream_audit
justification: Auditable raw layer and idempotent curated layer

rule: Land raw event; compare event_time to stored Silver event_time
rejected_record_handling: Retain in Bronze; flag for review if older than watermark; merge only if newest for key
justification: Prevents loss while preserving latest business state

rule: Newest event_time wins; older event never overwrites newer
rejected_record_handling: Retain in Bronze; mark ignored in audit when older
justification: Arrival order is not a reliable business ordering
